Poor paste transfer

3 root causes
High paste viscosity
Seen 4×
Spec 180–220 Pa·s Solder paste
Fix: Replace the paste; check paste age and floor life.
Low paste volume per aperture
Seen 2×
Spec 0.036–0.044 mm³ Solder printer
Fix: Clean the stencil underside; verify squeegee pressure.
High ambient RH
Not seen yet
Spec [your limit] Environment
Fix: Control humidity; check paste exposure time.
